# Draft:Biswaroop RC Publications

Biswaroop Roy Chowdhury is an author, public speaker, educator, and HRD Corp Certified and Accredited Trainer (Malaysia). His work includes lifestyle education programs, public workshops, digital learning initiatives, and the authorship of books launched at public events covered by mainstream media outlets.
Career and Public Work
Biswaroop Roy Chowdhury has developed a career as an author and public speaker, conducting workshops, seminars, and structured learning programs across India, Malaysia, and other regions. As an HRD Corp Certified and Accredited Trainer in Malaysia, he has led professional development sessions recognised under Malaysia’s human resource development framework.
Books and Publications
In addition to his public programs, Biswaroop Roy Chowdhury has authored several books that have been launched at media-covered events.
* Green Gold: The Neem Farmacy (2025)
* 1 Question That Can Save Your Life (2021)
Public Recognition and Events
Documented public events include:
* 2025 – Launch of Green Gold: The Neem Farmacy at Siri Fort Auditorium, New Delhi.
* 2021 – Launch of 1 Question That Can Save Your Life.
Organisational Background
Biswaroop Roy Chowdhury has been associated with training and educational organisations that support his workshops, publications, and digital learning programs. These platforms facilitate group programs, structured sessions, and outreach activities across India, Malaysia, and internationally.
Timeline
* 2021 – Public launch of 1 Question That Can Save Your Life.
* 2023–2024 – Workshops and digital education initiatives.
* 2025 – Launch of Green Gold: The Neem Farmacy at Siri Fort Auditorium.
